# factory-install

Materialize fetched runtime archives into one prefix, contained to it.

An MCP engine. forge resolves it by URI and calls a tool over stdio.

```yaml
engine: forge://github.com/alexandremahdhaoui/forge-factory/cmd/factory-install@v0.1.0
```

## Tools

| Tool | Does | Input | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| `install` | Lay fetched archives out under the prefix per the description's strip and picks. Writes under the prefix and nowhere else. | `InstallInput` | `InstallOutput` |

## Running it by hand

```sh
go run ./cmd/factory-install --mcp
```

It speaks JSON-RPC on stdin and stdout. Logs go to stderr, because
anything else corrupts the stream.
